case: A record states one payload field in `fields` and not in `type_fields`, which is the convention for a field an amendment added and must not be refused.
why: The registry states a payload in two places on purpose: `type_fields` is the payload as it stood and `fields` is what an amendment added, with `added_by` per field. The drift check therefore reads the UNION. A check that read `type_fields` alone would refuse every one of the eight records WORK-1.1 extended, which is a false exclusion of the convention itself.
